description: This PHP class defines a console command 'CacheClearCommand' for clearing cache namespaces in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base Command class and interacts with the CacheService to clear specific cache areas, providing success or failure messages via IO interfaces.

classes.name: CacheClearCommand
classes.description: A command class for clearing specific cache namespaces in the OrangeHRM system via console.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command, 'cache:clear'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing process for predefined namespaces, outputs success or failure messages, and returns the status.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs cache clearing for specific namespaces and outputs results.
